# assignmentB2JociePickhardt

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of assignmentB2JociePickhardt is to allow users to input four numeric parameters used in daily life and convert their units from imperial to metric, simulating moving from the US to Canada. 

## Installation

You can install the development version of assignmentB2JociePickhardt from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
devtools::install_github("jociepick/assignmentB2JociePickhardt")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

```{r example}
library(assignmentB2JociePickhardt)

moving_to_canada(5, 62, 15, 35)

```
